steps.title: Given I am on the home page
When I submit the contact form with a unique name, a valid email, phone, a unique subject and a 20+ character message
Then I see the heading "Thanks for getting in touch <Name>!" with my name
And I see "We'll get back to you about <Subject> as soon as possible." with my subject
And the contact form is no longer shown

specs.title: SCN-003: An empty submission keeps the form and reports every field

steps.title: Given I am on the home page
When I submit the contact form with every field empty
Then the contact form is still shown
And the validation errors mention Name, Email, Phone, Subject and Message

specs.title: SCN-004.1: The UI rejects a value one character outside a boundary (Phone 10)

steps.title: Given I am on the home page
When I submit the contact form with a valid enquiry whose Phone is 10 characters long
Then the form shows the error "Phone must be between 11 and 21 characters."

specs.title: SCN-004.2: The UI rejects a value one character outside a boundary (Subject 101)

Then the form shows the error "Subject must be between 5 and 100 characters."

specs.title: SCN-004.3: The UI rejects a value one character outside a boundary (Message 19)
